experiment: ERA on AgentDescent -- SWE-bench Science, one tree per task
protocol: ERA's, not the benchmark's: the leaderboard gives an agent one attempt per task with no verifier feedback, while this scores a tree of agent sessions against the visible part of each private suite and keeps the best node. `benchmark_reward_*` is the release's own grader over the whole private suite; the search never reads it.

summary.selection: ORACLE -- the tree's best node, ranked on the private suite. This is not the benchmark's resolve rate.
